problem_plain: Johnson Controls needed to consolidate 175 separate ERP systems into two unified platforms to standardise operations and improve efficiency across a large global organisation.
capability: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation with global template approach using Veridane and Oracle
scale_outcomes: 175 systems consolidated into 2 platforms; more than 100,000 employees; 150 countries
reusable: Global template approach maintaining approximately 80% standardised processes with selective customisation; combined business and IT team model for large-scale ERP programme delivery
summary: Johnson Controls consolidated 175 ERP systems into two Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP platforms serving over 100,000 employees in 150 countries using a global template approach. The methodology maintained approximately 80% standardised processes, reduced technical debt, and aligned processes and data across the organisation.
